mentions.name: Openfuse
mentions.description: This platform provides a centralized control plane for circuit breaker policies across a software stack. Users define reliability rules in one place, gain visibility into breaker states across services, and can react to failures without redeploying anything. It replaces scattered, per-service circuit breaker libraries or heavyweight service meshes.
mentions.problem: Circuit breakers are scattered across dozens of services with slightly different configurations and no single place to see what's happening during failures; existing options are either embedded libraries that leave every server stateful or full service meshes that are overkill for most teams.
mentions.audience: Teams running microservices or integration-heavy monoliths
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building Openfuse (https://openfuse.io), a centralized circuit breaker platform.
